surroundings.satellite: Esri World Imagery z17/z18 tiles composed by ribbingsforsbuild/sat-crop.mjs. bunkers.source: Esri World Imagery z18, sand classified per pixel by ribbingsforsbuild/detect-sand.mjs (2026-09-05) and reviewed by eye on the review crops; positions are pixel centroids through the exact tile->WGS84->EPSG:3006->local mapping (~0.31 m/px), so the residual error is the imagery's own orthorectification (a few metres) plus classification edges, not a reading error. Migration-only under the blocked Esri redistribution licence; no imagery is stored.

method.classifier: min(R,G,B) >= 132, max-min <= 75, R-B >= 30, G-R <= -6 — calibrated with --find on 19 known bunkers (sand reads rgb 183–214/170–193/136–161; the dry-grass mound at [533,-409] reads 166,162,127 with G-R -4 and is rejected on warmth; roofs fail on G>R or R-B<30)
method.components: 4-connected, >= 40 px; area 8–700 m²; within 75 m of a hole line or green; not inside water, buildings, parking, the yard or within 7 m of a road/track
method.review: 32 candidates on the played ground; 21 accepted as sand bunkers, 11 rejected (pale dry rough along the hole-4 tree clump, farmland east of the ditch, yard hardstanding and material piles, worn tee ground)
method.shape: ellipse from the pixel covariance: major/minor = 4 sigma, angle of the principal axis in the x/z plane

rules.green: grown from the surveyed centre on 0.5 m box-smoothed colour: ExG >= core - drop and brightness <= core + cap, opened, the component holding the centre, holes filled; six (drop, cap, smooth, open) readings from loose to tight (GREEN_SETS); accept 180–800 m², solidity >= 0.85, centroid within 6 m; the LARGEST compact reading wins
rules.deck: mown and laser 5x5 spread < 0.12 m, 60–600 m², within 25 m of the card mark, not within 60 m of the green; drawn as the oriented box of its cells (PCA axes, 3–97 percentile extents)
rules.fairway: mown mask opened 1 m and closed 3 m, water/buildings/parking removed, assigned to the nearest hole (line, green - 10 m, tee - 8 m) within 60 m, holes <= 200 m² filled, components >= 300 m²
rules.route: least-cost path over a 2 m grid (mown 1, within 20 m of mown 4, elsewhere 25, water 400) from the back tee (measured deck, else card mark) to the surveyed green centre; simplified 5 m, bends under 8° dropped; card marks at the card distance from the green along the line, snapped onto a deck within 25 m; where no deck fixes the back tee the line start slides to the card length

rules.relay: each traced ditch walked vertex to vertex by least-cost path along the top-hat within 40 m; kept where >= 0.10 m deep, gaps under 6 m bridged, runs >= 15 m
rules.crossing: valley score (across-depth minus 0.8 x along-slope over 8 directions) sampled every metre along each traced route; peaks >= 0.4 not in water, > 30 m from the tee and > 25 m from the green, > 12 m from a known ditch; snapped ±45 m and trimmed; runs >= 30 m and >= 0.2 m mean depth
rules.channel: top-hat components >= 0.30 m deep, 30–600 m², on open ground (tree-cover raster) within 45 m of a hole line or green, >= 2 m outside water/green/bunker/tee rings, >= 5 m from roads, tracks and paths, >= 10 m from a known ditch; principal-axis elongation >= 3 and >= 20 m long; the deepest cell per 2 m bin along the axis is the bottom; an end within 35 m of a water ring is extended to it by least-cost path; mean depth >= 0.25 m; >= 40 m long unless it reaches water

sourceWater.note: Lantmäteriet break-geometry lake polygons at 69.3 m, laser-exact inside item 653_44; folded into the Skagern ring by lake-union.mjs and not drawn on their own (the pack never carries this key)
